manySamples.summary: Authored purifier-example ASDF project and locked Quicklisp dependencies, with an installed native SBCL consumer. Library dependencies are not independent purifier sample projects. Inspection establishes useful concrete cases but not a broad independent upstream sample corpus covering different project structures; authored variants, dependency nodes and tests of one upstream project are not counted as separate projects.

longCompatibility.summary: Qlot 1.5.2/SBCL 2.6.8 and Quicklisp2024-10-12 pin/update test data do not establish execution of old Qlot/SBCL versions.
